{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CacheClient where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, ord)

-- | Cache node representation in K8s cluster
data CacheNode = CacheNode
  { nodeHost :: Text
  , nodePort :: Int
  , nodeSlot :: Int
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

-- | Connection pool for distributed cache
data CachePool = CachePool
  { poolNodes    :: [CacheNode]
  , poolStrategy :: RoutingStrategy
  , poolAuditLog :: MVar [AuditEntry]
  }

data RoutingStrategy = ConsistentHash | RoundRobin | Nearest
  deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { auditUser   :: Text
  , auditAction :: Text
  , auditKey    :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Namespace isolation for multi-tenant K8s deployment
newtype Namespace = Namespace { unNamespace :: Text }
  deriving (Show, Eq)

-- | Build the SQL statement for audit logging
-- Uses parameterized approach for known-safe fields
buildAuditInsert :: AuditEntry -> Namespace -> Text
buildAuditInsert entry ns =
  let table = resolveAuditTable ns
      -- The user field comes from K8s service account, considered trusted
      userVal = auditUser entry
      -- Action is from internal enum, safe
      actionVal = auditAction entry
      -- Key needs sanitization as it comes from client
      keyVal = sanitizeCacheKey (auditKey entry)
  in T.concat
       [ "INSERT INTO ", table
       , " (username, action, cache_key, ts) VALUES ('"
       , userVal, "', '"
       , actionVal, "', '"
       , keyVal, "', NOW())"
       ]

-- | Resolve audit table based on K8s namespace
resolveAuditTable :: Namespace -> Text
resolveAuditTable (Namespace ns) =
  T.concat ["audit_", sanitizeIdentifier ns]

-- | Sanitize SQL identifier (table/column names)
sanitizeIdentifier :: Text -> Text
sanitizeIdentifier = T.filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '_')

-- | Sanitize cache key for SQL insertion
-- Escapes single quotes by doubling them
sanitizeCacheKey :: Text -> Text
sanitizeCacheKey key =
  let escaped = T.replace "'" "''" key
  in T.take 256 escaped

-- | Hash-based routing to determine target node
routeToNode :: [CacheNode] -> Text -> CacheNode
routeToNode nodes key =
  let h = fnv1aHash key
      idx = h `mod` length nodes
  in nodes !! idx

-- | FNV-1a hash for consistent routing
fnv1aHash :: Text -> Int
fnv1aHash = T.foldl' (\acc c -> (acc `xor` ord c) * 16777619) 2166136261
  where xor = \a b -> fromIntegral (fromIntegral a `xor` (fromIntegral b :: Int))

-- | Perform cache lookup with audit trail
cacheGet :: CachePool -> Namespace -> Text -> Text -> IO (Maybe ByteString)
cacheGet pool ns user key = do
  let node = routeToNode (poolNodes pool) key
      entry = AuditEntry user "GET" key
      sql = buildAuditInsert entry ns
  -- Log the audit SQL (in production, this executes against PostgreSQL)
  modifyMVar_ (poolAuditLog pool) (\logs -> return (entry : logs))
  -- Simulate: executeSQL sql
  putStrLn $ "[AUDIT] " ++ T.unpack sql
  -- Simulate cache hit
  return $ Just (TE.encodeUtf8 $ T.concat ["cached:", key])

-- | Perform cache write with audit trail  
cacheSet :: CachePool -> Namespace -> Text -> Text -> ByteString -> IO ()
cacheSet pool ns user key value = do
  let node = routeToNode (poolNodes pool) key
      entry = AuditEntry user "SET" key
      sql = buildAuditInsert entry ns
  modifyMVar_ (poolAuditLog pool) (\logs -> return (entry : logs))
  putStrLn $ "[AUDIT] " ++ T.unpack sql
  return ()

-- | Initialize cache pool from K8s environment
initPool :: IO CachePool
initPool = do
  hostEnv <- lookupEnv "CACHE_NODES"
  let hosts = maybe ["cache-0.cache-svc.default.svc.cluster.local"]
                    (map T.pack . words) (fmap id hostEnv)
      nodes = zipWith (\h i -> CacheNode h 6379 i) hosts [0..]
  auditLog <- newMVar []
  return $ CachePool nodes ConsistentHash auditLog

-- | Invalidate cache entry across all nodes (admin operation)
cacheInvalidate :: CachePool -> Namespace -> Text -> Text -> IO ()
cacheInvalidate pool ns user key = do
  let entry = AuditEntry user "INVALIDATE" key
      sql = buildAuditInsert entry ns
  modifyMVar_ (poolAuditLog pool) (\logs -> return (entry : logs))
  putStrLn $ "[AUDIT] " ++ T.unpack sql
  -- Broadcast invalidation to all nodes
  mapM_ (\node -> putStrLn $ "  -> Invalidating on " ++ T.unpack (nodeHost node))
        (poolNodes pool)

-- | Health check endpoint for K8s liveness probe
healthCheck :: CachePool -> IO Bool
healthCheck pool = do
  logs <- readMVar (poolAuditLog pool)
  return $ length logs < 10000

-- | Extract service account identity from K8s-mounted token
-- In production, this reads from /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/
getServiceIdentity :: IO Text
getServiceIdentity = do
  saEnv <- lookupEnv "K8S_SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
  return $ T.pack $ fromMaybe "system:serviceaccount:default:cache-client" saEnv
